method: Visual inspection of the published chart image (data/digitized/ramesh-2013/figure3-craving.jpg); NOT pixel-calibrated digitization (no tool like WebPlotDigitizer was used -- no axis calibration points were programmatically registered). Values read directly off a simple 4-bar chart with a clearly gridded y-axis (0-75mm in 15mm increments), which is a low-ambiguity chart type (no overlapping markers).
confidence: moderate-high -- bars are cleanly separated and the axis is clearly gridded, but exact pixel-level precision is not claimed. Treat each value as +/- 1-2mm.
unit: mm (VAS 'I want marijuana', averaged across all post-smoking timepoints)
cross_check: Significance markers read off the chart (** at 4 puffs, *** at 6 puffs vs 0 puffs) are consistent with the exact text-reported comparisons in content/claims.json (ramesh-2013-craving-dose): 0>4 p<=.01, 0>6 p<=.01.
